national_law.name: Law 759
national_law.implementing_decrees: Two implementing decrees specifying EE/EI measures

competent_authority.name: National Cyber and Information Security Agency

management_liability.description: Statutory bodies may be sanctioned. NUKIB may temporarily prohibit management from exercising functions for at least 6 months. Mandatory appointment of cybersecurity manager, architect, and auditor.

incident_reporting.note: Essential entities must report ALL incidents (not just significant ones) where intentional conduct cannot be ruled out

supply_chain_requirements.description: NUKIB has authority to request extensive supply chain information and may prohibit or restrict use of certain suppliers. Government can limit insecure supply chain products for entities of strategic importance.

compliance_deadlines.registration: 60 days from entry into force (self-identification to NUKIB)
compliance_deadlines.security_measures: Up to 12 months from registration decision

penalties.essential_entities: CZK 250,000,000 (~EUR 10,300,000) or 2% of global annual turnover
penalties.important_entities: CZK 175,000,000 (~EUR 7,200,000) or 1.4% of global annual turnover
